theme_and_archetype.rationale: The requirement for a 'cinematic, futuristic, premium luxury edtech' experience with a 'spatial UI' aligns perfectly with a dark-first luxury archetype. It breaks the standard organic/light edtech mold to position Northend Educational World as a premium, next-generation Apple/Tesla-level educational brand.

brand_dna.name: Northend Educational World
brand_dna.core_identity: Authorised Unacademy franchise for Kashmir, India
brand_dna.vibe: Prestige, highly focused, futuristic command centre, aspirational, cinematic

rules.gradient_usage: Strictly limited to text-clipping for key headlines or subtle background glowing orbs. NO full-screen gradients. Use glass textures and particle fields instead.
rules.glassmorphism: Dark mode glass must have border-white/10 and backdrop-blur-2xl. Light mode glass uses border-black/5 and backdrop-blur-xl.

body.usage: Body copy, UI elements, Dashboard widgets

marketing_pages.grid: Bento Grid Protocol: MODE A ('Tetris' Grid). Asymmetrical 12-column layouts with generous p-8 to p-16 paddings. Elements must overlap slightly using negative margins to create depth.

dashboards.grid: Bento Grid Protocol: MODE B ('Control Room' Grid). Dense, pixel-perfect 4-column layouts. gap-4 or gap-6. All cards must stretch to fill vertical space identically (h-full).

motion_and_interaction.scroll: MANDATORY: @studio-freight/lenis for momentum scrolling on desktop.
motion_and_interaction.page_transitions: Framer Motion <AnimatePresence>. Cinematic dissolve: initial={opacity: 0, scale: 0.98}, animate={opacity: 1, scale: 1}, transition={duration: 0.8, ease: [0.16, 1, 0.3, 1]}.
motion_and_interaction.hover_states: Physical spring animations (stiffness: 400, damping: 30). Elevate elements with -translate-y-1 and intensify border/glow opacities.
motion_and_interaction.scroll_triggers: GSAP ScrollTrigger for pinning storytelling sections, fading in 3D assets, and parallax image depth.

3d_and_webgl_strategy.desktop: Full immersive R3F <Canvas>. Includes <Environment preset='city'>, <Float> wrappers for geometry, and <Points> for particle fields.
3d_and_webgl_strategy.mobile_degrade: CRITICAL: If window.innerWidth < 768px, unmount heavy R3F <Canvas> elements. Replace with Framer Motion 2.5D CSS parallax layers and background gradients. Ensure battery and performance are preserved on mid-tier Androids.
3d_and_webgl_strategy.home_hero_scene: A cinematic spatial environment featuring a subtle, slowly orbiting geometric mesh (like an abstract floating chinar leaf or a 'knowledge core' ring). Surrounded by a slow-moving particle field (amber dust). The camera tracks mouse movement slightly using useFrame.

CinematicHero.structure: Full viewport height. R3F Canvas strictly as a fixed background layer (-z-10). UI elements overlaid using absolute positioning. Heavy Outfit typography centered or asymmetrical.
CinematicHero.ui: Primary CTA uses a 'Tracing Beam' glowing border effect (Aceternity style).

CourseCard3D.interaction: On hover, Framer Motion handles a slight 3D tilt (rotateX, rotateY) tracking the mouse, while dropping a shadow-[0_0_30px_rgba(0,47,167,0.5)].
CourseCard3D.mobile: Standard CSS hover, no 3D tilt on touch.

StudentDashboard.style: Futuristic Command Centre. Uses 'Control Room' dense grid.
StudentDashboard.widgets: Orbital progress rings (SVG or minimal R3F). Live notice feeds with seamless marquee scrolling. Course tiles are solid dark surface-elevated with sharp 1px borders.

GlassPanel.style: Universal spatial UI container. backdrop-blur-2xl, background tint, 1px inner stroke.

ERP_Polished_Tile.style: Subtle premium layer. Light theme default. bg-white, shadow-sm, border-black/5. Soft Framer Motion entrance (opacity and slight Y translation). NO heavy 3D.

page_by_page_treatments.Home: Cinematic R3F particle hero. Hover-physics course cards. 3D animated number counters for student impact.
page_by_page_treatments.About: Scroll-triggered Lenis + GSAP storytelling. Parallax images of students/campus fading in against a deep navy spatial background.
page_by_page_treatments.Courses: Grid of CourseCard3D components. Path streams (SVG dashed lines with marching ants animation) connecting learning phases.
page_by_page_treatments.Scholarship: Immersive interactive experience. GlassPanel form overlaying a dark, moody background. Calculator feels like a Tesla config screen.
page_by_page_treatments.Centers: 3D Kashmir Map (React Globe GL or static R3F plane with glowing nodes). Nodes pulse in amber. Clicking a node flies the camera to the location.
page_by_page_treatments.Notices: Clean, list-based. Terminal/Technical look with sharp borders.
page_by_page_treatments.Results: Student success showcase. Masonry grid of testimonials. Images use black/white filter, turning full color on hover.
page_by_page_treatments.Jobs: Clean, professional layout. Swiss High-Contrast styling.
page_by_page_treatments.Contact: Spatial UI form in a GlassPanel.
page_by_page_treatments.Enroll & Login/Register: Minimal distraction. Full-screen split layout. Left side: Abstract 3D slow-loop video/canvas. Right side: Glassmorphic form.
page_by_page_treatments.Student Dashboard: The 'Command Centre'. Personal progress rings, holographic-style UI for upcoming classes.
page_by_page_treatments.ERP Backoffice: Light mode, ultra-clean, data-dense. Uses Shadcn charts and standard crisp tables. Fast and functional.

instructions_to_main_agent.file_type_rule: USE ONLY .js AND .jsx FILES. Do NOT create .ts or .tsx files.
instructions_to_main_agent.testing: CRITICAL: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a 'data-testid' attribute (e.g., data-testid='hero-cta-button', data-testid='course-card-physics').
instructions_to_main_agent.shadcn_usage: Use Shadcn mostly for the ERP backoffice (where functionality > cinematic visuals) and for complex accessible logic (Dropdowns, Dialogs). For the main public site, build pure HTML/Tailwind/Framer elements for maximum creative control over glassmorphism and bento grids.
instructions_to_main_agent.performance: Ensure all R3F Canvas components are wrapped in <Suspense>. Monitor the auto-degrade mobile strategy meticulously.
